name: Contradiction seeker
goal: {{task}} Done when a critic with a fixed budget finds no counterexample to this: {{claim}}

template.title: Contradiction seeker
template.summary: A critic hunts one counterexample to a stated claim on a fixed budget; finding none is a pass, finding one sends it back to the builder.
template.whenToUse: A claim can be broken by one concrete counterexample (a property, an invariant, an edge case), and a bounded search for it is worth more than an open-ended review.
template.notFor: Claims no single input can break (style, clarity), or proving correctness: a hunt that finds nothing is evidence, not proof.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Add a slugify(text) function to src/strings.ts that lowercases, strips accents and joins words with single hyphens.

slots.ask: What claim must hold, stated so that one counterexample would break it?
slots.example: slugify(text) always returns lowercase ASCII words joined by single hyphens, and slugify(slugify(text)) equals slugify(text).

description: A fast builder works; a critic in a fresh context tries to break the stated claim with one concrete counterexample, on a fixed effort. A counterexample goes back to the builder as a failing case; none found is a pass. The turn budget is the point: the hunt is bounded by design, and the round cap ends the loop regardless.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Make the task true in the code, with tests, so that the claim holds. On a later round, turn the counterexample in COUNTEREXAMPLE.md into a test and make it pass without special-casing that one input. Run `{{test-command}}` before you report.

nodes.name: Counterexample hunter
nodes.brief: Try to break the claim with one concrete counterexample: an input, how to run it, and the wrong result. Stop at the first one you can reproduce, or after about ten distinct attempts; finding none is a pass. You hunt; you do not fix.
outputs: COUNTEREXAMPLE.md: the reproducible counterexample, or the attempts that failed to find one

bar.name: No counterexample
bar.acceptance: A full hunt finds no input that breaks the claim, and `{{test-command}}` exits 0.
